name: eval01_龟兔再赛
desc: 寓言续写（易词）：被动/定从/过去完成/引语豁免/超长句；测词表边界（tortoise/hare 等真实超纲词）

passive: The new race was planned by Owl herself.
The start was fixed at the big stone.
The finish was set by the river.
The small bridge had been closed by the keeper of the wood.
Toby won the race, and the second place was taken by a very tired hare.
The lesson was remembered by every young animal in Maple Wood, and even the fastest runner now stopped to look at the world around him.
relcl: The morning light, which was soft and gold, lay over the grass.
The path that led up the hill was steep and full of little stones.
The animals who lived near the river all came to watch.
pastperf: Harry Hare had lost the great race a year before.
The small bridge had been closed by the keeper of the wood.
When Harry woke, Toby had passed the fallen tree.
overlong: The lesson was remembered by every young animal in Maple Wood, and even the fastest runner now stopped to look at the world around him.
